answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a unique onyx-sealed stake certificate whose issuance requires a costly proof-of-burn, forcing every new voyage into the ledger to carry real capital weight. Order flow is then routed through a ripple-weighted reputation graph where duplicated identities share one stake and dilute each other's liquidity rewards. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
